reading: The sketch lays out a full agency homepage: a plain-text nav, a huge three-band sliced 'MOTION' headline, a tilted red-orange 'NEW REEL 26' badge, a short paragraph of copy, a square 'See the reel →' button, a 4-row ruled index/list of works, and a vertical 'EST. 2014 — OSLO' label, all on a cream page with Helvetica/near-black type per the run-level note.
